worldmapplus.map.title: World Map
worldmapplus.option.flat_map.tip: Above the max. 3D height the view fades into the flat 2D map, so you can zoom out much further.
worldmapplus.settings.title: WorldMapPlus – Settings
worldmapplus.settings.max_3d_height.tip: How high the camera flies in the real 3D world. Above it the 2D map takes over (if on). Default: 358
worldmapplus.settings.start_height.tip: How high the camera flies when the map opens. Default: 48
worldmapplus.settings.zoom_speed.tip: How far one mouse wheel step goes up or down. Default: 5
worldmapplus.settings.flight_speed.tip: How fast the camera follows the target height. Low = soft, high = direct. Default: 5
worldmapplus.settings.hide_hud.tip: Hide hotbar and crosshair in the map view.
worldmapplus.settings.arrow_size.tip: Size of the player arrow. Default: 100 %
worldmapplus.settings.chunks_per_tick.ti: Chunks per tick for the 2D map. Higher = updates faster, but needs more performance. Default: 6
worldmapplus.settings.shading.tip: Draw slopes lighter and darker on the 2D map, like the vanilla map.
worldmapplus.settings.hide_clouds.tip: No clouds in the map view, so they don't cover the ground. Normal play keeps them.
worldmapplus.settings.camera.tip: Heights, zoom, flight and turning of the camera.
worldmapplus.settings.display.tip: Pause, HUD, clouds and player arrow.
worldmapplus.settings.map.tip: 2D map on/off, 2D only, updating, shading and death points.
worldmapplus.settings.discovery.tip: The 2D map only shows where you have been.
worldmapplus.settings.tilt_switch.tip: In the tilted view, switch to the 2D map already at this share of the max. 3D height, so no unloaded terrain is seen. Default: 60 %
worldmapplus.settings.rotate_sensitivity: How much the view turns when dragging with the right mouse button. Default: 5
worldmapplus.settings.rotate_inertia.tip: How long the view keeps turning after letting go. 0 = off. Default: 5
worldmapplus.settings.arrow_color.tip: Color of the player arrow. Default: red
worldmapplus.settings.discovery_on.tip: The 2D map is only uncovered around you, the rest stays black. The map is still loaded as usual.
worldmapplus.settings.discovery_radius.t: This many blocks around you are uncovered. Automatic = as far as the max. 3D height. Default: automatic
worldmapplus.settings.pause_game.tip: In singleplayer the world stops while the map is open (no pause menu). Not possible in multiplayer.
Below this camera height the arrow is hidden, because you can be seen there. 0 = always show. Default: 170 blocks
worldmapplus.settings.only_2d.tip: M always opens the 2D map directly, without the 3D camera.
worldmapplus.settings.death_points.tip: Shows a skull on the 2D map where you died.
How many of the last death points are shown. Default: 5
worldmapplus.welcome.title: WorldMapPlus is free
worldmapplus.welcome.message: Official download only on CurseForge and GitHub.
